_comment: Public address of the R2 bucket unfoldingword-media (Sweet Publishing images, PDFs and other uploads). Until unfoldingword.org's DNS is on Cloudflare this is the bucket's r2.dev address, which Cloudflare rate-limits and labels non-production. AT CUTOVER: attach media.unfoldingword.org as the bucket's custom domain and change base to https://media.unfoldingword.org (docs/cutover.md).
